text: ICICIBANK.NS is sitting 0.4% off its all-time high with a 16.2% five-year CAGR, but that 81% max drawdown from 2008 is the scar tissue you carry into every trade. I’d keep both stakes in cash until a genuine pullback gives a margin of safety; chasing all-time highs on a 10x timeline is how small accounts get blown up.
